examples.title: A personal budget tracker
examples.prompt: A personal budget tracker. Add income and expenses with an amount, a category and a date; see the month's balance and a breakdown by category; switch between months; and export the month as CSV. Everything is stored in the browser, and the app says so plainly.

examples.title: A recipe box
examples.prompt: A recipe box. Save recipes with ingredients and numbered steps, search by name or ingredient, scale the servings up or down with the quantities following, and mark favourites. Everything is stored in the browser, and the app says so plainly.
notes: It keeps recipes in the browser's storage and reads it without a fallback, so with site data blocked, or a stored value it cannot parse, the page stays blank.
